comment: The distinction between semantic governance and runtime services is well drawn, and the text correctly states that both are mutually necessary. What remains less explicit is how an approved semantic-governance decision becomes a machine-checkable constraint on data instances at the point of use. Making that handoff explicit would strengthen the connection between governance and operational conformance.
